# Incident notification template

Owner: Security manager, Example Ltd

## Notification stages

- Early warning: send to the supervisory authority within 24 hours of becoming aware.
- Intermediate update: send to affected customers within 72 hours.
- Final report: send to the authority and customers within 30 days.

## Message content

- What happened, in plain words: a short summary of the incident.
- Who is affected and how: the customer groups and the data involved.
- Actions taken and next steps: containment done and the planned fixes.
- Contact for questions: the security mailbox at Example Ltd.

## Sign-off

- The security manager approves each message before it is sent.
